cs.t: I came across this on AliExpress where RetroScaler sells these. Bought one for my PlayStation 2 and it works perfectly with my PlayStation 4 compatible controller. It's awesome :D And when I bought it I didn't even know that it was open hardware. So that just adds even more awesomesauce to the happiness I have for that product.
cs.th: BlueRetro: Multiplayer Bluetooth controllers adapter for retro game consoles
